country.match: Match each painter to the country they were born in.
country.odd: Three of these painters were born in {value}. Which one wasn't?
country.reverse: Which of these painters was born in {value}?

exclude.why: Rothko: American painter born in Latvia; country is contested
Kandinsky: Russian-born, worked in Germany and France; country is muddled
Bacon: Irish-born but known as a British painter
Chagall: born in the Russian Empire, now Belarus; country is disputed
Mucha: born in Austria-Hungary, now Czechia
Klee: German-Swiss; born in Switzerland but known as German
Repin: Russian-empire painter born in what is now Ukraine
El Greco: born on Crete, worked in Spain; country is muddled

rows.label: Frida Kahlo
rows.hook: paints vivid, unflinching self-portraits, often with her signature unibrow and pain on display

rows.label: Vincent van Gogh
rows.hook: painted swirling night skies and sunflowers, and famously cut off part of his own ear

rows.label: Yayoi Kusama
rows.hook: covers rooms, pumpkins and canvases in endless polka dots

rows.label: Andy Warhol
rows.description: American artist, film director, and producer (1928–1987)
rows.hook: turned soup cans and celebrity faces into pop art silkscreens

rows.label: Pablo Picasso
rows.hook: co-founded Cubism and painted a huge anti-war mural about a bombed town

rows.label: Michelangelo
rows.hook: painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling and carved a giant marble statue of a biblical hero

rows.label: Salvador Dalí
rows.hook: painted melting clocks and was known for a waxed, upturned mustache

rows.label: Claude Monet
rows.hook: painted water lilies and a harbor sunrise that gave Impressionism its name

rows.label: William Blake
rows.hook: wrote and illustrated visionary books of poems, including one about a fearsome tiger

rows.label: Caravaggio
rows.hook: used dramatic light and shadow in gritty, realistic scenes, and lived as a brawler on the run

rows.label: Jackson Pollock
rows.hook: dripped and splashed paint onto canvases laid out on the floor

rows.label: Rembrandt
rows.hook: painted a famous militia group scene and a long series of self-portraits

rows.label: Hieronymus Bosch
rows.hook: painted bizarre, monster-filled visions of heaven and hell, including a garden of earthly delights

rows.label: Francisco Goya
rows.hook: served as royal court painter, then made dark nightmare scenes like a giant devouring his son

rows.label: Gustav Klimt
rows.hook: painted shimmering gold-leaf works, including a famous golden embrace of two lovers

rows.label: Diego Rivera
rows.hook: painted huge public murals about workers and history, and married a famous self-portrait artist

rows.label: Georgia O'Keeffe
rows.hook: painted giant close-ups of flowers and bleached animal skulls in the desert

rows.label: Raphael
rows.hook: painted a gathering of ancient philosophers and graceful Madonnas for the Vatican

rows.label: Edvard Munch
rows.hook: painted a figure shrieking beneath a blood-red sky

rows.label: Mark Rothko
rows.hook: painted huge, glowing blocks of color that seem to hover on the canvas

rows.label: David Hockney
rows.hook: painted sunny swimming pools and splashy scenes of life in Los Angeles

rows.label: Henri Matisse
rows.hook: led the Fauves with wild color and made bold paper cut-outs late in life

rows.label: Paul Gauguin
rows.hook: left Europe to paint vivid, colorful scenes of island life in Tahiti

rows.label: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec
rows.hook: made posters and paintings of cabaret life in Montmartre, including the Moulin Rouge

rows.label: Wassily Kandinsky
rows.hook: pioneered fully abstract painting, inspired by music and color

rows.label: Pierre-Auguste Renoir
rows.hook: painted sunlit, soft-edged scenes of Parisian parties and bathers

rows.label: Albrecht Dürer
rows.description: German painter, printmaker, mathematician, and theorist (1471-1528)
rows.hook: made famous detailed prints, including a rhinoceros and a pair of praying hands

rows.label: Jan van Eyck
rows.hook: painted a double portrait with a tiny convex mirror and perfected oil painting detail

rows.label: Johannes Vermeer
rows.hook: painted quiet household scenes, including a girl wearing a pearl earring

rows.label: J. M. W. Turner
rows.hook: painted stormy, glowing seascapes, including an old warship being towed to its last berth

rows.label: M. C. Escher
rows.hook: made impossible staircases and interlocking patterns that loop endlessly

rows.label: René Magritte
rows.hook: painted a pipe labeled as not a pipe and men in bowler hats with apples for faces

rows.label: Peter Paul Rubens
rows.hook: painted lush, dramatic Baroque scenes of full-figured people and also worked as a diplomat

rows.label: Piet Mondrian
rows.hook: painted grids of black lines filled with blocks of red, yellow and blue

rows.label: Francis Bacon
rows.hook: painted raw, distorted screaming figures, often in three-panel works

rows.label: Sandro Botticelli
rows.hook: painted a goddess rising from the sea on a giant shell

rows.label: John Singer Sargent
rows.hook: was a society portraitist whose portrait of a woman in a black gown caused a scandal

rows.label: Paul Cézanne
rows.hook: painted still lifes of apples and a favorite mountain, paving the way for Cubism

rows.label: Raja Ravi Varma
rows.hook: painted Hindu gods and epic heroes in a realistic European style and spread them as prints

rows.label: Katsushika Hokusai
rows.hook: created a towering ocean wave with a small Mount Fuji behind it

rows.label: Marc Chagall
rows.hook: painted dreamy scenes of floating lovers and fiddlers over village rooftops

rows.label: Artemisia Gentileschi
rows.hook: painted powerful biblical heroines, notably a woman overpowering a general

rows.label: James McNeill Whistler
rows.hook: painted a portrait of his mother, titled as an arrangement in grey and black

rows.label: Jacques-Louis David
rows.hook: painted heroic scenes, including a general crossing a mountain pass on a rearing horse

rows.label: Alphonse Mucha
rows.description: Czech painter, illustrator and graphic artist (1860–1939)
rows.hook: made flowing Art Nouveau posters of women framed by flowers

rows.label: Pieter Brueghel the Elder
rows.hook: painted busy peasant festivals and a towering unfinished-looking Babel

rows.label: Edgar Degas
rows.hook: painted ballet dancers in rehearsal and backstage

rows.label: Georges Seurat
rows.hook: painted with tiny dots of color, including a Sunday afternoon on a park island

rows.label: Titian
rows.hook: was a Venetian master famed for rich red tones and portraits of emperors and kings

rows.label: Gustave Doré
rows.hook: illustrated Dante's Inferno and the Bible with dramatic engravings

rows.label: Édouard Manet
rows.hook: bridged realism and Impressionism with a barmaid scene at the Folies-Bergere

rows.label: Amedeo Modigliani
rows.hook: painted portraits with elongated necks and blank almond-shaped eyes

rows.label: Hans Holbein the Younger
rows.hook: painted Henry VIII's court and a portrait with a hidden stretched skull

rows.label: Joan Miró
rows.hook: painted playful, dreamlike stars, eyes and squiggles in bright primary colors

rows.label: Diego Velázquez
rows.hook: painted a royal princess with her attendants and the artist himself at an easel

rows.label: El Greco
rows.description: Greek artist, painter, sculptor and architect (1541–1614)
rows.hook: painted stretched, flame-like figures beneath twisting skies

rows.label: Max Ernst
rows.hook: was a Surrealist pioneer of collage and rubbing textures from objects

rows.label: Mary Cassatt
rows.hook: painted intimate scenes of mothers and children and exhibited with the Impressionists

rows.label: Caspar David Friedrich
rows.hook: painted a lone wanderer gazing over a sea of fog

rows.label: Paul Klee
rows.hook: taught at the Bauhaus school and drew whimsical figures like a twittering machine

rows.label: Dante Gabriel Rossetti
rows.description: English poet, illustrator, painter, and translator (1828-1882)

rows.label: Giotto
rows.hook: frescoed a chapel in Padua, helping break painting free of stiff medieval style

rows.label: Eugène Delacroix
rows.hook: painted a flag-waving woman leading a crowd over a barricade in a revolution scene

rows.label: Giuseppe Arcimboldo
rows.description: Italian painter of the late Renaissance (1527–1593)
rows.hook: painted portraits made entirely of fruit, vegetables and flowers

rows.label: John Constable
rows.hook: painted peaceful rural scenes, including a horse-drawn hay cart crossing a stream
